ucs.title: [LLM] Medusa pre-encryption defense-evasion chain (Defender tamper + shadow delete + recovery wipe)
ucs.description: Hunts the multi-step pre-encryption staging chain that Medusa operators run minutes before dropping gaze.exe per CISA AA25-071A: PowerShell tampering of Defender (exclusions / real-time off), vssadmin shadow deletion, bcdedit recovery disable, and stops of Defender/Sense services. Two or more of these techniques on one host inside a 30-minute window is the Medusa signature, not any single one.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sc.exe","net.exe") by _time Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval technique=case(
    match(process_name,"(?i)vssadmin\.exe") AND match(process,"(?i)delete.*shadows"), "shadow-delete",
    match(process_name,"(?i)bcdedit\.exe") AND match(process,"(?i)recoveryenabled\s+no"), "recovery-disable",
    match(process_name,"(?i)wbadmin\.exe") AND match(process,"(?i)delete.*catalog"), "backup-delete",
    match(process_name,"(?i)(powershell|pwsh)\.exe") AND match(process,"(?i)(set|add)-mppreference") AND match(process,"(?i)(exclusionpath|exclusionprocess|exclusionextension|disablerealtimemonitoring|disableioavprotection)"), "defender-tamper",
    match(process_name,"(?i)sc\.exe") AND match(process,"(?i)config") AND match(process,"(?i)(windefend|msmpsvc|sense|wdnissvc)") AND match(process,"(?i)disabled"), "service-disable",
    match(process_name,"(?i)net\.exe") AND match(process,"(?i)stop") AND match(process,"(?i)(windefend|msmpsvc|sense)"), "service-stop")
| where isnotnull(technique)
| bin _time span=30m
| stats dc(technique) as tech_count values(technique) as techniques values(process) as commands values(parent_process_name) as parents min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by dest user _time
| where tech_count >= 2
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 4h;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
    or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and ProcessCommandLine has "no")
    or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "catalog")
    or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Set-MpPreference","Add-MpPreference") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ExclusionPath","ExclusionExtension","ExclusionProcess","DisableRealtimeMonitoring","DisableIOAVProtection"))
    or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "config" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("WinDefend","MsMpSvc","Sense","WdNisSvc") and ProcessCommandLine has "disabled")
    or (FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("WinDefend","MsMpSvc","Sense"))
| extend Technique = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe", "shadow-delete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe", "recovery-disable",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe", "backup-delete",
    FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe"), "defender-tamper",
    FileName =~ "sc.exe", "service-disable",
    FileName =~ "net.exe", "service-stop",
    "other")
| summarize TechCount = dcount(Technique), Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            CmdLines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 6),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where TechCount >= 2   // Medusa-signature: chained evasion in one window, not lone vssadmin admin task
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 4h;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Img = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where (Img endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and Cmd has "delete" and Cmd has "shadows")
    or (Img endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and Cmd has "recoveryenabled" and Cmd has "no")
    or (Img endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and Cmd has "delete" and Cmd has "catalog")
    or ((Img endswith "\\powershell.exe" or Img endswith "\\pwsh.exe") and Cmd has_any ("set-mppreference","add-mppreference") and Cmd has_any ("exclusionpath","exclusionextension","exclusionprocess","disablerealtimemonitoring","disableioavprotection"))
    or (Img endswith "\\sc.exe" and Cmd has "config" and Cmd has_any ("windefend","msmpsvc","sense","wdnissvc") and Cmd has "disabled")
    or (Img endswith "\\net.exe" and Cmd has "stop" and Cmd has_any ("windefend","msmpsvc","sense"))
| extend Technique = case(
    Img endswith "\\vssadmin.exe", "shadow-delete",
    Img endswith "\\bcdedit.exe", "recovery-disable",
    Img endswith "\\wbadmin.exe", "backup-delete",
    Img endswith "\\powershell.exe" or Img endswith "\\pwsh.exe", "defender-tamper",
    Img endswith "\\sc.exe", "service-disable",
    Img endswith "\\net.exe", "service-stop", "other")
| summarize TechCount = dcount(Technique), Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            CmdLines = make_set(CommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 6),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where TechCount >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query:
source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 -@User:*$ (
  (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete* OR *DELETE*) AND @CommandLine:(*shadows* OR *Shadows* OR *SHADOWS*))
  OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled* OR *RecoveryEnabled*) AND @CommandLine:(*no* OR *No* OR *NO*))
  OR (@Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe) AND (@CommandLine:*Set-MpPreference* OR @CommandLine:*set-mppreference* OR @CommandLine:*Add-MpPreference*) AND (@CommandLine:*ExclusionPath* OR @CommandLine:*ExclusionProcess* OR @CommandLine:*ExclusionExtension* OR @CommandLine:*DisableRealtimeMonitoring* OR @CommandLine:*DisableIOAVProtection*))
  OR (@Image:(*\\sc.exe OR *\\SC.exe OR *\\SC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*config* AND (@CommandLine:*WinDefend* OR @CommandLine:*windefend* OR @CommandLine:*Sense* OR @CommandLine:*MsMpSvc*) AND (@CommandLine:*disabled* OR @CommandLine:*Disabled*))
  OR (@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\Net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*stop* OR *Stop* OR *STOP*) AND (@CommandLine:*WinDefend* OR @CommandLine:*windefend* OR @CommandLine:*Sense*))
)
ucs.rationale: Medusa (CISA AA25-071A) is one of the few crews whose playbook reliably chains all three: PowerShell Defender tamper, vssadmin shadow nuke, and bcdedit recovery disable within minutes of each other on the same host — usually right before gaze.exe drops. ucs.title: [LLM] Medusa encryption artifacts — .MEDUSA extension burst + !!!READ_ME_MEDUSA!!! note
ucs.description: Late-stage, ultra-high-confidence detection for the Medusa ransomware payload (gaze.exe) writing its trademark .MEDUSA file extension and the !!!READ_ME_MEDUSA!!!.txt ransom note. A single host emitting either signature is alert-grade; >25 file rewrites by one process is the encryption sweep itself.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.MEDUSA" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.medusa" OR Filesystem.file_name="*READ_ME_MEDUSA*.txt" OR Filesystem.file_name="*read_me_medusa*.txt") by _time Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_id Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| eval is_encrypted=if(match(file_name,"(?i)\.medusa$"),1,0)
| eval is_note=if(match(file_name,"(?i)read_me_medusa.*\.txt$"),1,0)
| stats sum(is_encrypted) as encrypted_count sum(is_note) as note_count values(file_path) as folders dc(file_name) as unique_files values(process_name) as encryptor min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by dest user process_id
| where encrypted_count >= 25 OR note_count >= 1
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackMinutes = 30m;
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackMinutes)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where FileName endswith ".MEDUSA"
    or FileName endswith ".medusa"
    or FileName matches regex @"(?i)!*read_me_medusa!*\.txt"
| extend IsEncrypted = iff(FileName endswith ".MEDUSA" or FileName endswith ".medusa", 1, 0)
| extend IsNote = iff(FileName matches regex @"(?i)!*read_me_medusa!*\.txt", 1, 0)
| summarize EncryptedCount = sum(IsEncrypted),
            NoteCount = sum(IsNote),
            UniqueFolders = dcount(FolderPath),
            SampleFolders = make_set(FolderPath, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessSHA256, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessId
| where EncryptedCount >= 25 or NoteCount >= 1   // ransom-note presence alone is alert-grade
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackMinutes = 30m;
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackMinutes)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
| extend FileNameLower = tolower(TargetFileName)
| where FileNameLower endswith ".medusa"
    or FileNameLower matches regex @"!*read_me_medusa!*\.txt"
| extend IsEncrypted = iff(FileNameLower endswith ".medusa", 1, 0)
| extend IsNote = iff(FileNameLower matches regex @"!*read_me_medusa!*\.txt", 1, 0)
| summarize EncryptedCount = sum(IsEncrypted),
            NoteCount = sum(IsNote),
            UniqueFolders = dcount(TargetFilePath),
            SampleFolders = make_set(TargetFilePath, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by DvcHostname, ActingProcessName, ActorUsername
| where EncryptedCount >= 25 or NoteCount >= 1
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Medusa Ransomware Encryption Artifact (.MEDUSA / READ_ME_MEDUSA)
id: 8f1a4d2b-9c3e-4f5a-b2d7-medusa01artifact
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of files with the .MEDUSA extension or the !!!READ_ME_MEDUSA!!!.txt ransom note dropped by the Medusa ransomware payload (gaze.exe), as documented in CISA AA25-071A.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa25-071a
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_extension:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.MEDUSA'
      - '.medusa'
  selection_note:
    TargetFilename|contains: 'READ_ME_MEDUSA'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.txt'
  condition: selection_extension or selection_note
falsepositives:
  - Negligible — extension and ransom-note name are payload-specific
level: critical
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| (TargetFileName=/\.medusa$/i or TargetFileName=/read_me_medusa.*\.txt$/i)
| IsEncrypted := if(TargetFileName=/\.medusa$/i, 1, 0)
| IsNote := if(TargetFileName=/read_me_medusa.*\.txt$/i, 1, 0)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, ContextProcessId], function=[sum(IsEncrypted, as=EncryptedCount), sum(IsNote, as=NoteCount), count(field=TargetFileName, as=UniqueFiles, distinct=true), min(_time, as=FirstSeen), max(_time, as=LastSeen)])
| EncryptedCount >= 25 or NoteCount >= 1
ucs.rationale: The .MEDUSA file extension and !!!READ_ME_MEDUSA!!!.txt note are unique to this crew's gaze.exe payload — no other ransomware family uses them. Single-event match on the ransom note name is alert-grade because the string is the crew's brand. The encrypted-count threshold catches the sweep itself for hosts the note hasn't landed on yet, while also giving the responder the SHA256 of gaze.exe via Ini
